target: one hidden STATIC HWND owned by a spawned same-user, same-integrity child process
actions: child creates one hidden window without activating it
parent reads production owner identity and sets a unique SetPropW value
child destroys the window and confirms IsWindow is false
parent observes GetPropW on the stale handle
child recreates one window on the same process and GUI thread
parent tests whether numeric HWND and property value recur
child destroys its final window and exits
retry_policy: one frozen attempt; preserve refusal or no-reuse as scoped outcome; no retry
scope: Tests same-integrity cross-process SetPropW/GetPropW and window-lifetime cleanup on this Windows host. It does not qualify elevated targets, all UIPI configurations, other desktops, or production runtime integration.
